notes.title: Patch #3 | 0.0.264
notes.content:
Howdy!

A few, but even more desirable additions are coming to your corner market!  For example, controller support and achievements!
Included is also an update to Performance update! The game should now run better and smoother.

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full controller support for menus & UI. 
[*] Rotate shelves/furniture using controller while placing them.
[*] Achievements are now available!
[*] New “Performant Mode” option for lower-end PCs.
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Plants and grass now sway in the wind more naturally.
[*] Optimized textures, reduced memory usage.
[*] No more random horse sounds when starting the game.
[*] Evening visuals improved → background mountains shifted for better lighting after 4 PM.
[*] Gamepad: price adjustment is now on LT instead of RT. - Architect Mode controls updated: use WASD instead of arrows
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Shadows close to player looks now better, fixed issue with artifacts.
[*] Fixed the "Large liquorice jar” showing in the wrong category.
[*] Fixed an issue where controls stopped working if you closed settings with the “X”.
[*] Fixed staircase collider mesh in General Store.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #2 | V0.0.255
notes.content:
Howdy shopkeepers,

We've just released the next Patch for Wild West General Store Simulator, which focuses on fixing some bugs.

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] We've fixed an issue where customers stand idle near a wall, and don't pick-up an item.
[*] We've fixed an issue where the employee remains in the product stack, instead of returning to the delivery area.
[*] We've fixed an issue with the axe throwing minigame, where it would count as loss, when the last target is hit.
[*] We've fixed an issue with the axe throwing minigame where the "Tomahawk" count incorrectly starts with "14/15"
[*] We'Ve fixed an issue, where the game could potentially freeze, when you take out a product from a shelf, while a customer wants to pick-up that product.
[*] We've fixed an issue with John, where he could not be properly saved during onboarding on his road to bakery.
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]

[list]
[*] The economy was updated.
[/list]

This means that Customers now filter their requested products by rack. If there is no meat rack placed in the shop, customers will not ask for products of this category.

notes.title: Early Access is available now!
notes.content:
Howdy shopkeepers!

We hope you are as ready as we are for your journey in the Wild West! After a successful demo run during Steam Next Fest in June, we collected a lot of valuable feedback from you, the Community. We used the time to tweak, enhance and improve every level of the game, so it's ready to start into it's Early Access phase in the best way possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

[h3]Wild West Supermarket Simulator is available now![/h3]

Open your very own Wild West Store, try to balance the sheets and ideally bring in a hefty profit, and react to random events that affect the supply and demand of your customer's needs. Also, if you want a more challenging approach than the "Standard" mode, just use "realistic prices" and live from every penny you get.

While playing, you can level up your store, expand the premises and gain access to new products through various minigames. Of course, you can also decorate your shop, as well as your homestead, while overlooking the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/5e0987b57a091fc7b41b64ffcc0d7e053ecce2c7.png[/img]

[h3]And, what's next to come?[/h3]

The next things we will focus on, are improving the game and [b]fix any bugs[/b] that may come up, as well as add [b]achievements[/b] and [b]controller support[/b].

We've also planned to add more [b]types of customers[/b], [b]new challenges for minigames[/b] and [b]extend the shelf management[/b].

And, Wild West Supermarket Simulator will get [b]more workers[/b] to hire, an [b]improved order book[/b] and [b]shelves for the storage room[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

[h3]Send us your feedback![/h3]

For Wild West Supermarket Simulator, we are very happy to receive a lot of feedback from you! And in order to sort stuff on our end in a better way, we created a Feature Upvote board, where you can simply add your feedback in a quick way - and upvote other's.

You don't have to create an account, enter your real email address (or one at all) or put in your real name. Just provide us with feedback. We will listen to your ideas and suggestions as much as possible in the future.

https://wwgss.featureupvote.com

We're looking forward to enjoying this journey with you together - and now we wish you much fun with your own store!

notes.title: Demo Update & New Title
notes.content:
Howdy shopkeepers,

We hope you're enjoying the demo! Today, we're bringing some changes to the Demo, that will mostly improve and fix stuff, but also add a new feature. Also, we will change the title of the game. But first, let's talk about the update.

[h3]Update notes version 0.0.210[/h3]

[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*] Employees can now stock shelves
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Changed the logo
[*] Changed the icon for assigning an employee to warehouse work
[*] The player can assign an employee to stock shelves via the employee menu (a new icon was added)
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with nighttime lighting
[*] Fixed a lighting issue after saving and loading the game
[*] Fixed a lighting issue when starting a new day in the game
[/list]

[h3]Improved[/h3]

[list]
[*] Employees who stock shelves should now fully work with the save/load system
[*] Improved the skybox during nighttime hours
[*] Improved performance after loading a saved game
[*] Improved evening lighting
[/list]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png"][/img]

As you will certainly have noticed (even without us pointing it out), we adjusted the title of the game and changed it from General Store to Supermarket.

Yes. Of course we are aware that technically in the Wild West there weren't any supermarkets, but stores and 'general stores' if they carry a variety of goods from food to tools and almost everything in between.

Yet that also means that the term might be historically accurate, but not so easy to understand. And since the general store of the Wild West is basically the granddaddy of modern supermarkets, we decided to call it like it is. 
You own the equivalent of a supermarket. In the Wild West. Simple as that.

You will feel right at home with the updated demo, its added features, bugfixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: What’s next in store?
notes.content:
Howdy Shopkeepers,  

Steam Next Fest is officially over.  

To all of you, who played the demo: Thank you. We deeply appreciate your interest in Wild West General Store Simulator. 
Also we'd like to thank you for the feedback you supplied. Every word of it is very important to us and helps us to improve the game, when it comes out later this year.   

Not only that, it was and is also very crucial in improving the demo.  
As you've noticed, we rolled out a few updates for the trial version during Steam Next Fest. And we will keep doing so, as we decided to keep the demo available until further notice.  

So if you haven't played the demo yet: We kindly invite you to a shopkeeping experience like no other.  And if you have played it, we would love for you to come back and see for yourself how we improved the gameplay experience with the update to version [u]0.0.202[/u], with all the details listed below.  

Either way: Thank you for your ongoing support. We absolutely appreciate it.  

We can't wait to share some more news about Wild West General Store Simulator in the near future.  

Until then!


[h3]Update notes version 0.0.202[/h3]

[b]Visual & Lighting Improvements[/b] 

[list]
[*] Improved shadows and lighting across the game - no more overly dark or pitch-black areas.
[*] Updated lighting at multiple times of day, including new lighting for 8:00, 14:00, and 20:00.
[*] Adjusted lighting inside the saloon and general store for better atmosphere.
[*] Fixed blurry textures on the startup screen.
[*] Improved building models and fixed issues with some objects appearing too complex or low quality at certain distances. 
[*] Added realistic footstep sounds inside buildings.
[*] Doors in saloons now have proper physics! 
[/list]

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] VRAM optimizations to help the game run smoother on a wider range of hardware. 
[*] New texture streaming system (optional, can be enabled in settings). 
[*] Faster loading times thanks to improvements in how the game prepares collision and navigation data. 
[*] Better texture management to prioritize important textures during gameplay.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Citizens are now more active: every 30 in-game minutes, new NPCs appear and roam around town, including riders on horseback. Up to 10 citizens can now be active at once.
[*] New cleaning task added: NPCs will now pick up empty boxes and dispose of them.
[*] Fixed issues where warehouse workers were mistakenly collecting empty boxes.
[*] Saloon colliders fixed to prevent getting stuck or walking through objects.
[/list]

[b]Controls & UI Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Further refined mouse input to reduce motion sickness (should feel smoother than before).
[*] Fixed several camera issues, including clipping through walls or behaving oddly when looking down. 
[*] New mouse sensitivity slider added.
[*] New VSync option added (off by default).
[*] Fixed issues with inventory tabs requiring awkward clicks.
[/list]

[b]Other Fixes & Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved font support for special characters in various languages.
[*] Fixed issues with NPC hairstyles.
[*] Removed unnecessary animations from citizens to improve performance.
[*] A new debug settings file is now generated to help us test and improve game stability.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for playing and testing![/b]

Your feedback helps us a lot - please continue reporting any bugs, visual glitches, or performance issues you encounter.

notes.title: Start playing the Demo now!

[p]Howdy shopkeepers,[/p]

[p]We have some good news today for ya, the Demo for [b]Wild West General Store Simulator[/b] is available now for you! The demo will also be featured in next week's [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! So, make sure to participate and open up your General Store now![/p]

[p]Immerse yourself in the Wild West, where you run your own General Store. You provide your customers with goods of daily life, and of course some extras. Prepare shelves with Beans, Bread, Meat, Tools and other things, people want to buy. Earn money, expand your Shop, decorate your home and play some Minigames in-between.[/p]

[*] Dynamic customer demands
[*] Full-fledged economy system
[*] Random events
[*] “Casual Prices” and “Realistic Prices” modes
[*] Minigame “Tomahawk Throwing Contest”

notes.title: "What Can I Do Ya For?" - Wild West General Store Simulator is coming!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=OXo4MF1lm2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Howdy shopkeepers,

with [b]Wild West General Store Simulator[/b] SunDust, a label of Toplitz Productions, is bringing you a wild west experience, without the need of being a gunslinger! Saddle up and get a taste of what it's like to own and run the granddaddy of nowadays' supermarkets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

In [b]Wild West General Store Simulator[/b] you're not only the shopkeep, but also the decorator, when you take care of your day-to-day business tryin’ to keep your account afloat, the shelves stocked and the doors open. Wrangle inventory and deal with travellin’ traders and fellow peddlers to keep your source of income from runnin’ dry. Give your customers a shoppin’ experience finer than Miss Molly’s fried chicken - from when they enter your esteemed establishment to the final cling of the coin at the register. Happy customers will be back as sure as a fly on a cow pie. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/6a85c70e1570bd3ae5e19ae80871277ee1754fe6.jpg[/img]

With a darn fine economy model workin’ under the surface, you’ll need to make the right prices for your goods and keep a sharp eye on what the folks as well as regulars want, if you aim to line your pockets with gold before you close for the night - and walk to your beautiful home overlooking the town. Use them hard-earned bucks, fins and dixies to grow your store, bring in new products or beautify the place with a fresh lick o’ paint. And if you grow tired of goin’ all solo, hire yourself a helper, or two. Or three. Just remember - out here, the customer’s always right and money talks.

Once the sun dips down, head back to your homestead, a place you can build up just the way you like. Kick off your boots, watch out for snakes, and rest up for the long haul. As they say, New York wasn’t built in a day, and before you know it, you're the most legendary storekeep this side of the great lakes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

Get ready for a true Western shop experience when the demo for [b]Wild West General Store Simulator[/b] hits the trail soon!

Add the game to your wishlist now, so you won't miss any future announcements:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690760/Wild_West_General_Store_Simulator/
